newsitem.title: UK: Nelson Hurst says gets 84 mln stg cash offer.
newsitem.headline: Nelson Hurst says gets 84 mln stg cash offer.

text.p: British marine insurance firm Nelson Hurst Plc announced on Wednesday a recommended cash offer for the company by FG (UK) Ltd, a wholly-owned company of Forbes Group Ltd.
It said in a statement that offer is for 185 pence for each Nelson Hurst share and values the company at around 84 million stg.
Nelson Hurst said the price represented a premium of 43 percent to Tuesday's closing market price of 129.5 pence.
Nelson Hurst directors have irrevocably undertaken to accept the offer in respect of 5.1 million shares, around 11.17 percent of the issued share capital.
Forbes, a leading provider of risk management, insurance and employee benefits related services in South Africa, owns 9.94 percent of Nelson Hurst currently.

Once the offer is unconditional, David Woodward and John Percy-Davis will continue in their current roles of chairman and chief executive of Nelson Hurst for at least the next three years, the company said in a statement.
